Im zweiten Geschäftsbereich TAFKA helfen wir Unternehmen, KI und Automatisierung praktisch in ihre Arbeit zu integrieren.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine berufserfahrene Person, die digitale Projekte eigenständig führt, technische Themen sicher einordnet und bei Bedarf direkt in die Umsetzung geht. An einem Tag steuerst du ein Kundenprojekt, am nächsten löst du ein Problem mit Shop, DNS oder Tracking, schneidest ein Video in DaVinci Resolve oder entwickelst mit Claude und Codex einen besseren Workflow.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du bringst Ordnung in komplexe Situationen, kommunizierst klar und führst Projekte zuverlässig zum Ergebnis. Wenn du Verantwortung magst, digitale Systeme schnell verstehst und einen vielseitigen Arbeitsalltag suchst, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Aufgaben

  • Digitale Projekte führen: Du übernimmst Vino-Digital-Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst Beteiligte und hältst Zeit, Qualität und nächste Schritte im Blick.
  • Kunden sicher begleiten: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für ausgewählte Partnerweingüter, führst Termine, übersetzt Ziele in klare Arbeitspakete und löst Probleme proaktiv.
  • Systeme weiterentwickeln: Du sammelst wiederkehrende Anforderungen, priorisierst Verbesserungen, formulierst saubere Briefings für Entwicklung und Automatisierung, testest neue Funktionen und dokumentierst den fertigen Prozess.
  • Technische Themen lösen: Du arbeitest sicher mit CMS, Domains, DNS-Einträgen, Formularen, Tracking und Integrationen. Bei Fehlern grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein und organisierst eine belastbare Lösung.
  • Web und E-Commerce umsetzen: Du pflegst und verbesserst Seiten in Shopify, WordPress oder vergleichbaren Systemen und kannst kleinere Anpassungen selbst durchführen.
  • Videos produzieren: Du schneidest Social-, Performance-, Schulungs- und Kunden-Videos in DaVinci Resolve, inklusive Auswahl, Dramaturgie, Ton, Untertiteln und passenden Exportformaten.
  • AI-first arbeiten: Du nutzt Claude und Codex täglich für Planung, Recherche, Dokumentation, Troubleshooting, Text, Prototyping und kleine technische Umsetzungen. Ergebnisse prüfst und verbesserst du eigenständig.
  • TAFKA unterstützen: Je nach Auslastung übernimmst du passende Aufgaben in KI-, Automatisierungs- oder Content-Projekten von TAFKA, etwa Projektkoordination, Prototyping, Video-Deliverables oder Qualitätssicherung.
  • Standards verbessern: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Reibung, entwickelst Vorlagen und Prozesse weiter und sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen im Team wiederverwendbar werden.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einer Agentur, einem Digitalunternehmen, einem E-Commerce-Team, einem Start-up oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit.
  • Du hast mehrere digitale Projekte mit eigener Kunden- oder Stakeholder-Verantwortung geführt und kannst konkret erklären, welche schwierigen Situationen du gelöst und welche Ergebnisse du erreicht hast.

  • Du nutzt Claude, Codex oder vergleichbare KI-Werkzeuge routiniert und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Qualität, Tempo oder Problemlösung verbessert hast.
  • Du dokumentierst Entscheidungen und Prozesse so, dass andere damit weiterarbeiten können.
  • Du arbeitest auf Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau und kannst dich im beruflichen Alltag auf Englisch verständigen.
  • Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz in Berlin arbeiten: 3 Tage pro Woche

Ein Studium ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Berufspraxis, dein Urteilsvermögen und die Ergebnisse, für die du bereits Verantwortung getragen hast. Erfahrung mit Vibe Coding, APIs, Webhooks oder Automationen ist willkommen.

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung: Du führst eigene Projekte und hast direkten Einfluss auf Kunden, Abläufe und Produktqualität.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Arbeit mit erkennbarem Kern: Projektmanagement bildet deine Basis. Technik, Systeme, Video und KI geben dir Raum, weitere Stärken einzusetzen.
  • Zwei spannende Arbeitsfelder: Du arbeitest überwiegend für Vino Digital und kannst dich zusätzlich in ausgewählte KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte von TAFKA einbringen.
  • AI-first-Umfeld: Claude, Codex und moderne Automatisierungswerkzeuge gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Experimente können schnell zum neuen Standard werden.

Du hast schon erlebt, wie digitale Projekte in der Realität laufen: mit Kundenwünschen, Abhängigkeiten, technischen Überraschungen und Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck. Du behältst den Überblick, packst selbst mit an und findest einen gangbaren nächsten Schritt.

What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to build AI applications and agentic workflows for Motorway, taking them from rapid prototype through to production-grade systems that deliver measurable value.

You'll take a problem that isn't fully defined yet and see it through to a reliable system running in production: the prompting, the retrieval, the agent design, the evals, the guardrails, the monitoring. You own that whole stack. There's no separate team who "productionises" your work later.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. If that's the work you want to do, we're not precious about the route you took to get here. Some of us came through data science and machine learning and deliberately built up our software engineering; others came the other way.

In this role, you will:

  • Own AI features end to end, from an ambiguous problem through to a reliable, observable system that real customers depend on.

  • Build the retrieval and data foundations these features stand on, and treat retrieval quality as a first-class engineering problem rather than a tuning exercise.

  • Design evaluation and monitoring approaches that make quality, reliability and safety measurable rather than assumed.

  • Build AI applications and agents using LLMs, orchestration, APIs and data systems, applying solid production software practices throughout.

  • Make the calls on models, cost and latency that shape what a feature costs us to run, and document the reasoning so others can follow it.

  • Prototype quickly, work out what is reusable, and harden the patterns that work into components the rest of the team adopts.

  • Raise the quality of the work around you through code review, design feedback and the standards you set by example.

  • Represent your technical decisions directly to product managers and stakeholders, translating model behaviour into business consequence.

About you

  • You've shipped AI or ML systems that real users depend on, and you've stayed close enough to production to know how they behave when they break.

  • Strong Python, and SQL you genuinely use. A lot of this work is data work: assembling grounding data, building golden datasets, and digging into why something failed.

  • You've invested deliberately in your software engineering craft: testing, error handling, CI/CD, observability, and the MLOps practices that keep things healthy once they're live.

  • You're hands-on across the GenAI stack: LLM APIs, retrieval and vector stores, agents with tool use, and structured outputs, running on cloud infrastructure (we use AWS and GCP).

  • You have a real point of view on evaluation, most likely because you've been caught out by a system that looked fine and wasn't.

  • You can reason about how models fail, including hallucination and prompt injection, and what that means for someone who trusts the output.

  • You know when to reach for a model, when something simpler will do, and when to stop.

  • You're a constructive reviewer, and colleagues are better off for having worked alongside you.

You could be a great fit if

About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

Backed by over $170M in funding (Series C), we are scaling rapidly across product, engineering, and go-to-market. AI is not a bolt-on feature at 9fin; it is the core differentiator for the next phase of the company.

You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.

You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.

 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for your area, with a focus on building and evolving our AI products

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into problem statements that identify root causes, not just symptoms

  • Shape the next generation of agentic AI products: multi-step reasoning workflows, tool orchestration, and autonomous task completion for financial professionals

  • Demonstrate a working understanding of the challenges specific to building with LLMs, including managing hallucinations, evaluating output quality, and designing for non-deterministic systems

  • Use confidence-building methods (prototypes, user research, data analysis) to understand how users will interact with AI-powered products before committing to full builds

AI Quality & Data

  • Use the team's AI evaluation framework (LLM-as-judge protocols, quality thresholds, SME eval cycles) to validate and improve the products you ship

  • Contribute to the data strategy for your product area: annotation quality, ground truth curation, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time

  • Proactively identify and track metrics that measure client and business benefit, working with the team on continuous model evaluation and improvement

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work

  • Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

  • Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

  • Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

  • Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in FinTech or B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years focused on ML or GenAI products

  • Working knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation methods (not just "AI concepts" at a high level)

  • Experience shipping AI products where output quality is probabilistic: you know how to define "good enough" and iterate from there

  • Comfortable reading Python notebooks and SQL to interrogate model outputs and usage data

  • Track record of shipping AI products where you managed the tension between ML research/exploration and production delivery constraints

  • Collaborative leadership style with strong stakeholder management; you build relationships that empower your team to achieve outcomes

  • User-centric communication skills: you can explain AI capabilities and limitations to clients and internal stakeholders without overselling or underselling

  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are energised by the challenge of building something new

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, legal tech, or data/analytics platforms

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or regulatory/compliance workflows

  • Experience with NLP applied to document analysis (contracts, legal filings, financial reports)

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, tool use patterns, or multi-step AI workflows


The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. You may have started your career as a lawyer, paralegal, or credit analyst, or you may have been a PM at a legal tech company. You are able to hold a substantive conversation about credit agreements, covenant packages, and how legal language governs capital structures. A sharp PM from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate rapid domain immersion will also be considered.

  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives with a blank page. You are comfortable defining strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing roadmap. You can synthesise ambiguous inputs into a clear direction and bring a team with you.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are great at prioritising, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • You've got hands-on experience with AI. You have experience with or a working knowledge of AI and LLMs, including how to evaluate model outputs in production environments. You understand what good looks like when AI is applied to high-stakes, precision-dependent workflows, and you can engage meaningfully with engineering teams on evaluation design and quality standards.

  • You work in an AI-native way. You use generative AI tools as a natural part of how you work: prototyping ideas, conducting research, reviewing PRDs, and building agents or automated workflows to extend your own productivity. You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

  • You thrive building from zero. You are energised by the opportunity to define something new rather than optimise something established. You move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct based on evidence.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

The Account Executive, Strategic, is responsible for managing and expanding relationships with key strategic accounts. This role involves a deep understanding of the client's business, the ability to develop strategic plans to increase revenue, and ensuring client satisfaction through excellent service. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sales, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex negotiations.

Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships with strategic clients. Act as the main point of contact and advocate for client needs within the company.

  • Strategic Business Planning: Develop a thorough understanding of key client needs and requirements. Work closely with clients to devise and implement strategic plans that align with their business goals and drive mutual growth.

  • Sales Targets: Achieve and exceed sales quotas within assigned portfolio by identifying and closing business opportunities.

  • Market Analysis: Conduct research and analysis to understand industry trends, competitive landscape, and client feedback to inform strategic planning and identify new business opportunities.

  • Reporting and Forecasting: Provide accurate forecasts and track key account metrics. Report on the status of accounts and transactions, and monitor sales performance against goals.

  • Contract Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms for both the client and the company.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience selling to large, complex F100 businesses, demonstrating a successful track record of meeting or exceeding targets, preferably in a similar industry or role.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.

  • Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.

  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Above and beyond: Trained in Command of the Message and MEDDPICC

First 30 days:

  • Understanding the Company and Product: Gain a deep understanding of the company's products or services, value proposition, and the competitive landscape. This includes completing all necessary onboarding training and familiarizing oneself with the company culture and processes.

  • Relationship Building: Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.

  • Client Familiarization: Start to get acquainted with the portfolio of strategic accounts, including reviewing account histories, previous interactions, and current contracts or agreements. Initial meetings with some key clients may also take place to introduce yourself as their new point of contact.

First 90 Days:

  • Strategic Planning: Develop detailed strategic plans for each key account, identifying opportunities for growth, potential challenges, and strategic objectives. This should be done in collaboration with clients and internal teams.

About the Role

We're looking for a Project Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of a large-scale localization program for a multinational gaming publisher. This customer ships localized content across dozens of titles, platforms and languages, and the program spans in-game text, marketing and UA content, cinematics and trailers, and supporting print and digital collateral.

You'll act as a key operational point of contact for the account, coordinating linguists, DTP and video specialists, and internal stakeholders to hit release-critical deadlines. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who has managed localization programs for a game publisher before and is comfortable owning complex, multi-workstream schedules under tight deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of localization projects for the account, from initial quoting and scoping through scheduling, resourcing and budget tracking, to final delivery and invoicing, across multiple concurrent titles and languages.

  • Manage transcreation and marketing localization workstreams, ensuring tone, intent and cultural nuance are preserved for user acquisition, marketing and in-game copy.

  • Coordinate subtitling, voiceover (AI and human) and video localization for trailers, cinematics and other video assets, including timing, rendering, editing and final QC of localized video files.

  • Oversee desktop publishing (DTP) workflows for localized packaging, manuals and marketing collateral, working with DTP specialists to maintain layout fidelity across languages.

  • Run thorough linguistic and mechanical/functional QC on every project, tracking issues to resolution and feeding recurring themes back into style guides, glossaries and linguist onboarding.

  • Manage content intake, review cycles and publishing workflows in coordination with the customer's content and web teams.

  • Support vendor management, including onboarding and evaluating linguists and other specialist vendors for the account.

  • Support other project managers on the account, sharing best practice on production workflows and quality standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience as a project manager in the localization industry, with direct experience delivering programs for a game publisher or games customer.

  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple concurrent, deadline-driven workstreams.

  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication in English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with additional localization or workflow platforms beyond those listed above.

  • Familiarity with quality frameworks such as ISO 17100 or ISO 9001.

  • Experience working with global, multi-time-zone teams.

  • The opportunity to work on high-profile, high-visibility programs for a global brand.

We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Heidi Evidence is clinical decision support with no commercial influence: nothing shapes what a clinician sees except clinical quality. Getting there means earning the trust of the organisations that hold the world's clinical knowledge, the journals, publishers, guideline bodies, professional societies and universities, and running large information-gathering programs across the NHS. That is the work of this role.

You'll sit next to our founder across partnerships, evidence and strategic projects, and you'll own the machinery underneath them. Hundreds of contacts, documents, deadlines and follow-ups, all current. AI-agent workflows doing the repetitive multi-step parts of outreach at a scale no one could reach by hand, with you auditing what comes out and drawing the line where a human has to look. The role starts part-time and grows with what you show you can carry. It fits an F3 or F4 doctor who wants into health tech, product and partnerships without putting their NHS experience on a shelf.

This is a part-time role, with the potential to become full-time.

What you’ll do

  • Run information-gathering, outreach and partnership programs across NHS organizations, end to end.

  • Build the tracking systems that hold it together: contacts, documents, deadlines, responses, follow-ups, one place, always current.

  • Set up AI-agent workflows for the repetitive, multi-step parts of the work, then keep them running in production.

  • Audit what those agents produce. Find the failure modes, fix the workflow, decide where human review is non-negotiable.

  • Write to NHS teams, publishers, societies and universities in a register they trust.

  • Map the clinical knowledge landscape: who holds what, who decides, which conversations to open first.

  • Prepare founder-level partnership meetings, keep accurate notes and close every action.

  • Surface risks, gaps and decisions early. Short updates, no surprises.

If we’d worked together the last 6 weeks

  • You'd have designed an outreach wave to several hundred NHS trusts, handed the first pass to an agent workflow, and caught the small percentage it got wrong before anything left the building.

  • You'd have mapped the UK guideline and specialty society landscape, then told us which five conversations actually move Evidence forward.

  • You'd have joined a founder call with a major clinical publisher, written the notes and closed every action inside the week.

  • A tracker someone had outgrown would have been rebuilt properly, so nothing now waits on a person remembering.

  • You'd have found a manual process, automated it, and taught the team to run it without you.

What you’ll need

  • 2+ years owning complex operational, clinical or partnership work, though we care more about what you’ve shipped than years on the clock.

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone’s day.

  • Fluency with AI tools that goes past using them. You’ve built agent workflows or automations other people now depend on, and you know their failure modes.

  • Composure across many open threads. Nothing you own drops, and you can tell which thread to pick up first.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Useful, not essential

  • Experience working in or closely with the NHS.

  • Medical training at FY2 level or beyond, particularly if you’re currently F3 or F4.

  • A current NHS affiliation and NHS.net address. Useful, not required, and any NHS account must be used in line with your organisation’s policies.

  • A feel for UK hospital workflows and how clinicians reach information at the point of care.

  • Familiarity with the clinical journals, publishers, guideline bodies, societies and universities that hold medical knowledge.

  • A background in health tech, clinical informatics, research, quality improvement, product operations or an early-stage company.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 

 

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

We’re scaling fast across the US and Europe, and our global team of almost 2000 colleagues continues to grow, and fast! As we expand our reach, launch new products and enter new markets, we need to stay sharp, scalable and human. That’s where you come in.


We’re looking for a People Partner to join our high-performing team and partner with leaders to deliver people strategies that drive performance, engagement, and scalable growth. As a People Partner, you’ll work closely with senior leaders to translate company priorities into actionable people plans. You’ll bring clarity, commerciality, and care to everything you do, enabling leaders to make confident decisions and empowering teams to thrive.


Due to the recent acquisition and ongoing integration of two organisations alongside our huge growth ambitions, this role is for someone who thrives in fast paced, scaling environments and knows how to bring clarity, commerciality, and dedication to employee experience in fast-scaling teams.


You’ll be responsible for implementing core people processes, enabling change initiatives, and ensuring we’re building a culture that reflects our values as we scale.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll bring insight, challenge and clarity to business decisions, team structures, and leadership plans. With huge growth plans comes ambiguity and a need to adapt our approach regularly; you’ll be comfortable navigating unknowns and bring confidence in others through ambiguity.

  • You’ll be a trusted adviser and coach, ensuring leaders have the mindset, capability, and confidence to lead their teams effectively on people topics, from performance and development to team dynamics and organisational change.

  • Work with Senior Leaders and Managers to co-create people priorities aligned to business goals and our Perk Values.

  • Provide scoped options and sound recommendations on people topics across the full employee lifecycle, including org design, high performance culture, and leading change.

  • Implement and manage key people processes (e.g. performance reviews, engagement surveys, talent planning) in your functions, ensuring quality and consistency.

  • Partner leaders to embed a high performance culture through multiple touchpoints such as the performance process, ensuring objectives, feedback, and development conversations drive high performance.

  • Use a range of data insights including People Data, Engagement Results, performance, and external sources to proactively partner the business; you’ll diagnose challenges, track progress, recommend improvements, and monitor progress against agreed initiatives.

  • Co-deliver change management with Senior Leaders and Managers, ensuring buy-in, clear communication, leader enablement, and smooth implementation.

  • Identify capability gaps and partner with the relevant functions to address them, including through the creation and delivery of learning content.


What success looks like

  • You start with business impact in mind, and you apply your knowledge and experience to the context of Perk to deliver business impact while balancing the employee experience.

  • Leaders in your functions feel equipped and confident to lead their teams through growth and change, and to drive performance, engagement and team development.

  • Core people processes are delivered with consistency, quality, and impact.

  • People data such as attrition and absence remain healthy, while engagement and performance metrics in your functions improve, with clear links to actions you’ve partnered on.

  • Change initiatives and project delivery in your remit are implemented smoothly, with positive feedback from leaders and teams.


What you’ll bring

  • Experience in a People Partner role partnering with Revenue functions and working in fast-moving tech companies

  • A track record of partnering and influencing senior leaders.

  • Strong understanding of organisational design, how to drive high-performance culture, leadership development, and leading change

  • A coaching mindset and excellent communication skills. You know when to challenge and when to guide.

  • Experience developing and enabling leaders and managers

  • Comfort operating across regions and time zones, with experience partnering with international teams

  • A bias for clarity, consistency, and care in everything you do


What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Granite, a Bifrost portfolio company, builds sovereign AI infrastructure for Europe: compute, energy and a new generation of sovereign AI technology, running in modular, liquid-cooled containers it specifies, builds and operates itself. Europe is deciding right now where its AI workloads are going to live, and most of the available answers are American. Granite is one of very few teams building the alternative at all three layers at once, run by entrepreneurs with multiple cloud and infrastructure exits behind them. The first datacentres are going live and more sites are in build.

Granite is hiring a Marketing Manager to build the path from a campaign to a sales conversation: the marketing operating rhythm, the lead generation engine, and the CRM discipline that turns interest into qualified pipeline. This is the first dedicated marketing hire, so you build the function rather than inherit it.

You will report to the CMO and sit in Commercial Leadership, close to the people who own revenue.

What you'll do

You are the marketing department. There is no team beneath you, no agency roster waiting and no brand system in place, so you buy the specialist capability you need and do the rest yourself. You are measured on pipeline rather than on output.

  • Have one integrated marketing calendar running on a weekly cadence within 90 days, with every vendor coordinated against it. You own the calendar, the cadence, the vendor roster, and the movement of work from idea through execution to measurement.
  • Make the CRM the heartbeat of the commercial organisation by month 6. Every lead entering with a defined source and campaign attribution, qualification criteria in place, MQLs and SQLs tracked, and dashboards showing pipeline contribution by campaign and channel.
  • Build the lead generation engine across performance marketing, LinkedIn, account-based marketing, events, partnerships, thought leadership, content and website conversion, so that every activity captures interest into the CRM. The objective is not traffic or followers.
  • Own performance marketing end to end, measured on cost per qualified lead, cost per target account engaged, conversion to sales conversation and pipeline generated. Not on vanity metrics.
  • Make marketing a predictable contributor to pipeline within 12 months, with a recurring cadence between Marketing, Sales and Customer Success that turns deployments into customer insight, case studies, campaigns and new leads.

What we're looking for

  • At least five years in B2B marketing, ideally in technology, infrastructure, cloud, AI, data centres or energy, where the buyer is technical and deals take months to close.
  • You have built a demand generation engine yourself and carried its number. We will ask which number you owned, what it was when you took it on, and what it was when you left.
  • You are still hands-on. You write the emails, brief the agencies and build the campaigns in the CRM. There is no team here to delegate to, and there will not be one for at least a year.
  • You have worked somewhere without a brand system, a budget precedent, a demand generation team or SDRs. If you have always had those around you, tell us what you would do differently without them.
  • You have hired and managed agencies, freelancers and performance partners on a budget you controlled.
  • You can name the CRM and marketing automation systems you have run, and explain how you tracked a lead from first touch through to a closed opportunity.
  • You work closely with Sales, and you can explain a technical product to a non-technical buyer in writing.
  • You live in Europe and can work hybrid.

You do not need to be the best copywriter, designer, media buyer or performance marketer yourself. You brief those people, judge their work, and keep it pointed at the same strategy.

This is for you if you want to own the whole system rather than one channel in it, and you would rather be measured on pipeline than on output. It is not for you if you need a team, a brand book and a demand generation function already in place to do your best work.

About Granite

You are the first dedicated marketing hire at a company building infrastructure Europe does not currently have, with the operating model still open enough that you define it rather than inherit it.

  • A direct line to the CMO and a seat in Commercial Leadership, close to the people who own revenue and the decisions that shape it.
  • A category still being defined. Sovereign AI infrastructure is early enough that the positioning work is real, and the brand you build is the one the market learns.
  • Scope that grows with the company. As Granite moves from first sites to a fleet, the function you own grows with it, and you will be the person who decides what the second and third marketing hires do.

Process

  • Intro call with Bifrost Recruitment
  • In-depth interview with the CMO
  • Case or work sample
  • Psychometric assessment
  • Final conversation with the leadership team
  • References and offer

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to take ownership of the datasets and evaluation workflows that underpin our AI Safety work. You'll turn real-world product data into reliable, well-structured datasets for training and evaluating models, and help build the processes and infrastructure to continuously assess how those models perform in production.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of data science, ML, AI safety, and policy. You'll work closely with safety researchers, engineers, and policy specialists to translate complex safety requirements into practical data and evaluation systems - starting hands-on with collection, analysis, and labelling, then building the methodologies, contributor networks, and quality standards that let this work scale.

In this role, you will

  • Own safety datasets end-to-end: collection, cleaning, labelling, quality control, versioning, and readiness for training and evaluation.

  • Translate safety policy into clear, consistent labelling and evaluation criteria, working closely with policy specialists.

  • Design and manage labelling processes, including sourcing, onboarding, and overseeing external contributors to a high quality bar.

  • Build evaluation workflows for models in production, using real-world data to track performance and surface issues.

  • Develop lightweight Python/SQL pipelines and tooling to make data work faster and reproducible, partnering with ML engineers on what "training-ready" looks like.

Who you are

  • Experience as a Data Scientist, or similar, working with real-world datasets and ML models.

  • Strong grasp of what makes a good dataset: collection, cleaning, sampling, labelling, quality control, evaluation.

  • Comfortable with Python and SQL for analysis and practical data workflows.

  • Strong critical thinking and judgement - comfortable with ambiguity and nuance, and able to turn complex guidelines into consistent, scalable decisions.

  • Autonomous and a clear communicator, able to work across disciplines (policy, engineering, research) in a fast-moving, still-forming environment.

Bonus points

  • Experience in AI safety, trust & safety, content moderation, or fraud/abuse detection.

  • Experience building datasets or evaluation frameworks, or with adversarial/safety-focused ML.

  • Experience managing human-in-the-loop labelling processes, dataset versioning, or ML pipeline tooling.

  • Experience operationalising guidelines with policy or legal teams.

Location

This role is based in London, where you'll work closely with our AI Safety and Policy teams.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

data.description:
Wir suchen einen Senior Platform Engineer für den Aufbau, die Weiterentwicklung und den Betrieb einer Kubernetes-basierten Plattform auf Bare-Metal-Infrastruktur für geschäftskritische Anwendungen. Die Rolle verbindet Plattformautomatisierung, Cloud-native-Integration, Sicherheit, Observability und operative Verantwortung in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld.

Key Facts
Start: 15.10.2026
Dauer: Nicht bekannt
Auslastung: 112 %
Einsatzart:
Einsatzort: Stuttgart
Einsatzland: Deutschland

Ihre Aufgaben
•Technische Konkretisierung von Plattformanforderungen und Überführung in umsetzbare Lösungsansätze in Abstimmung mit dem Platform Domain Architect und den beteiligten Fachteams
•Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung einer weitgehend automatisierten und reproduzierbaren Kubernetes-basierten Plattform auf Bare-Metal-Infrastruktur für geschäftskritische Anwendungen bis zur Betriebsfähigkeit und zum Go-Live
•Umsetzung wiederverwendbarer Plattformfunktionen für die Bereitstellung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung von Kubernetes-Clustern, Servern und weiteren Infrastrukturkomponenten
•Entwicklung, Implementierung, automatisierter Test und Integration von Kubernetes-Controllern und -Operatoren für Cluster- und Anwendungsbereitstellung, Anwendungen ohne eigene GitOps-Mechanismen sowie Server- und Netzwerkkonfiguration
•Weiterentwicklung der automatisierten Bare-Metal- und Kubernetes-Bereitstellung einschließlich Hardware- und Betriebssystem-Lifecycle, Cluster-Provisioning und Anbindung von BMC-Schnittstellen
•Weiterentwicklung von GitOps- und Infrastructure-as-Code-basierten Automatisierungslösungen einschließlich der erforderlichen Test- und Integrationsverfahren zur Reduzierung manueller Eingriffe
•Integration externer Systeme und Infrastrukturkomponenten über APIs, deklarative Schnittstellen und controllerbasierte Mechanismen
•Konzeption und Umsetzung von Observability für Plattform und Anwendungen mit Metriken, Logs, Traces und Alerting sowie clusterinternen und clusterübergreifenden Sichten und bedarfsgerechter Zugriffstrennung
•Konzeption und Umsetzung automatisierter Backup-, Restore- und Recovery-Verfahren für Plattformkomponenten, Persistent Volumes und Datenbanken einschließlich externer Sicherungsziele, überprüfbarer Wiederherstellungsverfahren und konkreter Ausfallszenarien
•Konzeption und Umsetzung von Hochverfügbarkeitsmaßnahmen sowie definiertem Systemverhalten bei Ausfällen zur Verbesserung von Stabilität, Wiederherstellbarkeit, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Sicherheit über Cluster- und Schutzzonengrenzen hinweg
•Konzeption und technische Umsetzung von Sicherheitsvorgaben durch Admission Control, richtlinienbasierte Validierung und Mutation von Ressourcen sowie weitere Hardening- und Threat-Detection-Maßnahmen
•Planung und Umsetzung technologischer Weiterentwicklungen bestehender Plattformkomponenten zur Realisierung neuer Plattformanforderungen
•Analyse komplexer Fehlerbilder über mehrere technische Schichten hinweg sowie Durchführung und Begleitung von Wiederanlauf- und Funktionstests
•Unterstützung des stabilen und sicheren Plattformbetriebs einschließlich Incident- und Störungsbehebung, Wiederherstellung des Regelbetriebs, operativer Änderungen und Anpassungen, operativer Backup-, Restore- und Recovery-Vorgänge, Go-Live- und Hypercare-Phasen sowie der technischen Nutzbarkeit im laufenden Betrieb
•Durchführung von Upgrades, Releases, Patches und sonstigen operativen Lifecycle-Maßnahmen sowie Pflege und Anpassung bestehender Konfigurationen
•Erstellung und Übergabe technischer und betriebsbegleitender Dokumentation sowie Durchführung von Wissenstransfer und Betriebsunterstützung

Muss-Anforderungen
•Mindestens 6 Jahre einschlägige operative Erfahrung in einer Senior-Platform-Engineering-Rolle für Kubernetes-basierte Plattformen
•Erfahrung in der Konzeption, technischen Umsetzung, Integration und wesentlichen Weiterentwicklung von Kubernetes-basierten Plattformen
•Praktische Erfahrung mit der automatisierten und reproduzierbaren Bereitstellung sowie dem Lifecycle-Management von Bare-Metal-Systemen, Servern und Kubernetes-Clustern
•Erfahrung mit Bare-Metal- und Kubernetes-Automatisierung sowie mit GitOps, Infrastructure as Code und deklarativen beziehungsweise controllerbasierten Automatisierungsmechanismen
•Umfassende praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung oder wesentlichen Weiterentwicklung von Kubernetes-Controllern und/oder -Operatoren, die produktiv eingesetzt wurden
•Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Kubernetes Day-2-Operations, Lifecycle Management, Upgrades sowie der Analyse und Behebung komplexer technischer Störungen
•Erfahrung mit der Konzeption und technischen Umsetzung von Observability für Plattformen und Anwendungen, einschließlich Metriken, Logging, Tracing, Alerting sowie clusterinterner und clusterübergreifender Sichten
•Erfahrung mit der Konzeption, Automatisierung und praktischen Überprüfung von Hochverfügbarkeits-, Backup-, Restore- und Recovery-Verfahren einschließlich definierter Ausfallszenarien und Wiederherstellungstests
•Erfahrung mit der Konzeption und technischen Umsetzung von Kubernetes-Security, Policy Enforcement, Admission Control, richtlinienbasierter Validierung und Mutation von Ressourcen sowie weiteren Hardening- und Threat-Detection-Maßnahmen
•Erfahrung mit der Integration externer Systeme und technischer Schnittstellen über APIs, deklarative Schnittstellen und vergleichbare Mechanismen
•Breite technische Erfahrungsbasis sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe und nicht vollständig spezifizierte Aufgaben eigenständig über mehrere technische Schichten hinweg bis zu einer produktiv nutzbaren Lösung zu bearbeiten und die Ergebnisverantwortung zu übernehmen
•Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, in kritischer Infrastruktur oder in einem vergleichbaren regulierten beziehungsweise sicherheitskritischen Umfeld
•Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
•Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
•Bereitschaft zur Sicherheitsüberprüfung nach SÜG und zum entsprechenden Pre-Screening
•Mindestens eine persönliche Referenz im DACH-Raum sowie mindestens eine persönliche Referenz zu Platform Engineering für eine produktive Kubernetes-basierte Infrastruktur
•Verfügbarkeit ab Oktober beziehungsweise November 2026
•Bereitschaft zur Nutzung von Atlassian Confluence und Jira als vorgegebene Kollaborations- und Dokumentationswerkzeuge

Kann-Anforderungen
•Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Kubernetes-Controllern und/oder -Operatoren mit der Programmiersprache Go
•Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte strukturiert, verständlich und überzeugend zu präsentieren
•Ausgeprägte Ausdrucksfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte klar zu vermitteln
•Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit und konstruktiven Interaktion in technischen Teams

Weitere Informationen

Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer und siehst hinter den Kulissen, wie eine Marke und ihre Firma wirklich funktionieren. Arbeitsort ist überwiegend unser Showroom in München, dazu etwa zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche als Richtwert.

Dein Alltag:

  • Du bestellst und behältst im Blick, was wir brauchen, von Verpackung über Etiketten und Labels bis zu Magazinen und Material für den Showroom, und bleibst nah an unseren Lieferanten, damit alles funktioniert.

Darüber hinaus:

  • Du planst mit uns Events und empfängst Gäste im Showroom.
  • Du begleitest Shootings und Kampagnen von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigstellung.
  • Deine ehrliche Meinung zu neuen Ideen ist gefragt.

Qualifikation

  • Unternehmergeist.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Ästhetik, Nachhaltigkeit, Qualität und Menschen.
  • Du stehst gerne vor und hinter der Kamera und schneidest (oder möchtest es lernen).
  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch und Englisch sicher.
  • Erfahrung mit Shopify oder Social Media ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung.
  • Du kannst mit deiner Studien oder Prüfungsordnung belegen, dass das Praktikum vorgeschrieben ist.

Benefits

  • 800 € pro Monat, eine der besten Praktikumsvergütungen, die eine Marke dieser Größe in München zahlt.

  • Unser Showroom mitten in München als Arbeitsplatz, dazu die Möglichkeit, einen Teil der Woche aus dem Homeoffice zu arbeiten.
  • Zugang zur ganzen Marke, zu Shootings, Events, Handel und Brand Ambassadors.
  • Ein echter Weg in eine feste Rolle, wenn es auf beiden Seiten passt.

Wenn du immer das Gefühl hattest, dass du zu viel über alles nachdenkst, vor Ideen sprühst und in keine Schublade passt, dann bist du hier richtig.

Für die Bewerbung schicke uns bitte keinen Lebenslauf und kein Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach ein Video unter dreißig Sekunden: wer du bist, was du zuletzt gemacht hast und warum HACOY. Leg bitte den Nachweis aus deiner Studien oder Prüfungsordnung dazu, dass das Praktikum vorgeschrieben ist.

So geht es weiter:

  1. **Du schickst uns dein Video an unsere Email Adresse.

  4. Wenn es sich für beide Seiten richtig anfühlt, starten wir.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Maximilian Rupp,

Gründer HACOY

Du kommst aus dem Maschinenbau und willst Vertrieb nicht nur über Zahlen führen? Du weißt, wie man Handelsvertretungen erfolgreich steuert, obwohl sie einem nicht disziplinarisch unterstellt sind? Und du willst auch als Vertriebsleiter nah an Kunden, Märkten und Technik bleiben?

Dann wartet hier eine Aufgabe mit echtem Einfluss auf dich.

Für ein mittelständisches Maschinenbauunternehmen aus der Region Aachen suchen wir im Rahmen einer geplanten Nachfolge einen Vertriebsleiter International (m/w/d). Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den internationalen Vertrieb und erhältst perspektivisch Prokura.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest den internationalen Vertrieb und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung.

  • Du führst sechs Vertriebsmitarbeiter, die internationale Märkte verantworten.
  • Du steuerst 20 bis 30 Handelsvertretungen weltweit – auch ohne direkte Weisungsbefugnis.
  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kunden weiter und baust gezielt Neugeschäft auf.
  • Du entscheidest, welche Vertriebspartner funktionieren, entwickelt werden oder ersetzt werden müssen.
  • Du bleibst nah an Kunden und arbeitest eng mit Konstruktion und Fertigung zusammen.

Gerade die Handelsvertretungen spielen eine zentrale Rolle. Wachstum entsteht zunehmend in Märkten, die über externe Partner bearbeitet werden.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen bewusst keinen branchenfremden Vertriebsleiter.

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre im internationalen Vertrieb von erklärungsbedürftigen Investitionsgütern im Spezial-, Sonder- oder Anlagenmaschinenbau gearbeitet.
  • Du hast Handelsvertretungen, Agenten oder Distributoren aufgebaut und aktiv gesteuert.
  • Du hast bereits ein Team disziplinarisch oder nachweisbar fachlich geführt.
  • Du kennst sowohl inhabergeführte Kunden als auch strukturierte Einkaufsorganisationen.

Ein technisches Studium in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen passt gut.

Eine gleichwertige technische Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis ist ebenfalls möglich.

Besonders interessant ist dein Profil, wenn …

… du bereits Erfahrung mit der Verarbeitung von Schaumstoff, Gummi, Kork oder verwandten flexiblen Materialien gesammelt hast.

Spanisch oder Französisch sind ebenfalls ein Plus. Gleiches gilt für die Zusammenarbeit mit einer eigenständig arbeitenden Auslandsgesellschaft, beispielsweise in den USA.

Diese Punkte sind keine Mindestanforderung. Materialkenntnisse können aufgebaut werden – belastbare Maschinenbauerfahrung dagegen nicht.

Unser Mandant ist ein mittelständisches Maschinenbauunternehmen mit eigener Entwicklung und Fertigung in der Region Aachen.

Das Unternehmen entwickelt erklärungsbedürftige Maschinen für internationale Kunden. Jeder Auftrag verbindet Vertrieb, Konstruktion, Fertigung und die spätere Abnahme beim Kunden.

Vertrieben wird sowohl direkt als auch über ein weltweites Netz aus Handelsvertretungen. Hinzu kommt eine eigenständig arbeitende Tochtergesellschaft in den USA.

data.description:
80 Beats Medical is a Berlin-based medical technology company developing innovative solutions for cardiovascular and vascular diagnostics.

Our VICORDER® platform enables non-invasive assessment of vascular health Building on this established technology, we are expanding our clinical diagnostic portfolio by combining medical device technology with advanced data analytics and AI.

Our goal is to transform complex physiological and cardiovascular data into reliable, clinically meaningful insights that can support earlier risk detection and better-informed clinical decisions.

We are a growing, international team working at the intersection of medical devices, software, data science, and clinical research.

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Data Engineer to help build the data and AI infrastructure behind our next generation of medical diagnostic solutions. You will work with high-frequency physiological and clinical data, developing secure and scalable data pipelines and supporting the transition of machine learning models from research into production-ready clinical applications.

You will work closely with our software, clinical, and regulatory teams in a highly interdisciplinary environment.

Tasks

  • Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure data ingestion and transformation pipelines. Implement automated ingestion, validation, lineage tracking, and quality monitoring.
  • Develop and maintain reusable data libraries, transformation logic, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure full compliance with GDPR, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (EU), HIPAA (US) and other global regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with implementation of Role-based access control (RBAC), Encryption in transit and at rest (HSM/KMS), Data anonymization & pseudonymization workflows and Consent handling and audit mechanisms.
  • Participate in security audits, compliance reviews, and certification efforts.
  • Operationalize AI pipelines including model deployment, monitoring, drift handling, versioning, and automated retraining.
  • Deploy explainable AI tooling (SHAP/LIME) into the pipeline for auditability and compliance.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows for data and ML workloads.
  • Develop Python-based analytics scripts, reusable data modules, and feature engineering logic.
  • Support visualization of workflows.
  • Ensure reproducibility and model traceability across the full lifecycle.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data science, AI, Cybersecurity, or similar.
  • 5+ years of experience building secure, compliant cloud-based data ecosystems ( for regulated data domains.
  • Hands-on experience with time-series data, sensor data, or biomedical/wearable data.
  • Knowledge of statistical programming
  • Strong understanding of ML approaches for classification, anomaly detection, and prediction using high-frequency data.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages
  • Advanced experience with Orchestration, Data frameworks, and Infrastructure automation.
  • Proven cross-functional communication skills.
  • Clear, documentation-driven engineering approach.

GOOD TO HAVE

  • Experience with multilevel longitudinal data, missing data strategies, and clinical outcome modeling.
  • Good working knowledge of either AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Hands on experience with Python and/or JavaScript including libraries for ML such as TensorFlow and PyTorch and visualization libraries such as Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or Streamlit
  • Previous work with Airflow, Dagster for Orchestration and Prefect, Spark, dbt, Kafka for data frameworks and Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm for infrastructure automation.
  • Knowledge of medical data formats (FHIR, HL7, DICOM).
  • Management of encryption standards and secure authentication

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A supportive and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients and healthcare professionals. You are at the forefront of developing technology that saves lives – what else is there?

Join our innovative Berlin team as a Data Scientist / Data Engineer to revolutionize cardiovascular diagnostics through cutting-edge technology and international collaboration. Be part of healthcare's future today!

What You'll Do
  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.

  • Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.
 
An ideal candidate should have

Required:

  • 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
  • Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
  • Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.
  • A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
  • Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
  • Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
  • Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

  • A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
  • A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker.
  • Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).

  • A purpose-driven mission: building software that's reliable, accessible, and user-centered — making a real difference for people.
